An '''encrypted comlink''' was a [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] that was capable of sending encrypted signals. It was used various covert operatives and [[Commando/Legends|commando]] units, including the [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance Special Forces]] [[Pathfinders/Legends|Pathfinders]].<ref name="NRSP">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/NewRepublicStatPack|text=New Republic Stat Pack|nobackup=1}}</ref>
